expectations.text: Runs day.py brief rather than computing routines or capacity by hand
expectations.evidence: Actions list `python3 day.py brief today --json`, and the capacity figures it quotes (155 min free, 124 plannable) come from that script.

expectations.text: Raises the unclosed earlier day before planning
expectations.evidence: The first message opens with "Monday 2 Nov was never closed. It has 6 blocks and none has an outcome." before any planning.

expectations.text: Its first reply asks exactly one question
expectations.evidence: The first reply has one question, "How do you want to close it?", with options (a), (b) and (c).

expectations.text: Does not list every candidate task
expectations.evidence: No candidate menu is shown: tasks come one per message, and only two are walked before the time runs out, although the final preview does name the three left-out videos.

expectations.text: Writes nothing before a confirmed preview
expectations.evidence: The preview says "Nothing has been written yet. Save this plan and close Monday? yes / change" and all writes are listed as not run.
